description: A pact with a text body and no Content-Type (its type is detected as text/plain), answered with the same text and no Content-Type: both read the reply as the pact's type and compare the text
source: staged plan S1.6; ADR 0036; pact_matching::match_body, which picks the body matcher by the pact's content type when the reply's agrees with it or has none, and compare_bodies' match_text and match_octet_stream
